text: An overseas elector who is entitled to vote in a parliamentary election in pursuance of an overseas elector's declaration is also entitled to vote as an overseas elector in a European Parliamentary election.

As now, only British citizens – as defined by the British Nationality Act 1981 – resident abroad and not subject to any incapacity will be entitled to register to vote as overseas electors; no other types of British nationality (for example British National (Overseas), or British subject) will be eligible.
The period of time either since the attestor was added to the register, or since the last annual publication of the register, whichever is the shortest.
More specifically, they will remain registered until the end of the 12 month period beginning with the date when their entry in the register first takes effect.
